verses.sloka: ततः संतप्त हृदयः स्मरन् निग्रहम् आत्मनः ।विनिःश्वस्य विनिःश्वस्य कृत वैरो महात्मना ॥१-५७-१॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ saṁtapta hṛdayaḥ smaran nigraham ātmanaḥ ।viniḥśvasya viniḥśvasya kṛta vairo mahātmanā ॥1-57-1॥

translations.english: "O Rama to these words of king Trisanku, the hundred sons of the sage angrily reacted:
translations.hindi: ON # काम्भोज निप्र पर्वत के दक्षिण में बतलाया गया हे) पे के निवासी “काम्भोजाः” कहलाते है | इस देश की वर्तमान स्थित अफगानि- स्तान बतलाई जाती है अश्व स्थान का अपभ्रंश “फगा निस्वान?) है। पञ्चपञ्चाशाः सगः —:0:— ततस्तानाकुलान्‌ इष्टवा विश्वामित्रास्त्रमो हितान्‌ । वसिष्ठश्चोदयामास कामधुक्सृज योगतः

verses.sloka: स दक्षिणाम् दिशम् गत्वा महिष्या सह राघव ।तताप परमम् घोरम् विश्वामित्रो महातपाः ॥१-५७-२॥
verses.transliteration: sa dakṣiṇām diśam gatvā mahiṣyā saha rāghava ।tatāpa paramam ghoram viśvāmitro mahātapāḥ ॥1-57-2॥

translations.english: 'O Evilminded one having been refused by the Guru true to his word, how could you bypass him and approach us who are mere off shoots (of the main).

verses.sloka: फल मूल अशनो दान्तैः चचार महत् तपः ।अथ अस्य जज्ञिरे पुत्राः सत्य धर्म परायणाः ॥१-५७-३॥
verses.transliteration: phala mūla aśano dāntaiḥ cacāra mahat tapaḥ ।atha asya jajñire putrāḥ satya dharma parāyaṇāḥ ॥1-57-3॥

translations.english: For all the kings of the Ikshvakus race, their chief priest is their Guru. It is not possible to bypass the spiritual preceptor who is true to his word preceptor.

verses.sloka: हविष्पन्दो मधुष्यन्दो दृढनेत्रो महारथः ।पूर्णे वर्ष सहस्रे तु ब्रह्मा लोक पितामहः ॥१-५७-४॥
verses.transliteration: haviṣpando madhuṣyando dṛḍhanetro mahārathaḥ ।pūrṇe varṣa sahasre tu brahmā loka pitāmahaḥ ॥1-57-4॥

translations.english: When an adorable sage like Vasishta has already said, it is not possible, how can we help you conduct such a sacrifice?

verses.sloka: अब्रवीत् मधुरम् वाक्यम् विश्वामित्रम् तपो धनम् ।जिता राजर्षि लोकाः ते तपसा कुशिक आत्मज ॥१-५७-५॥
verses.transliteration: abravīt madhuram vākyam viśvāmitram tapo dhanam ।jitā rājarṣi lokāḥ te tapasā kuśika ātmaja ॥1-57-5॥

translations.english: O Best one among men you are childish. Return to your capital. O Monarch the most venerable Vasishta is capable of conducting sacrifices performed by anybody in the three worlds. How can we dishonour him'?

verses.sloka: अनेन तपसा त्वाम् हि राज ऋषिर् इति विद्महे ।एवम् उक्त्वा महातेजा जगाम सह दैवतैः ॥१-५७-६॥
verses.transliteration: anena tapasā tvām hi rāja ṛṣir iti vidmahe ।evam uktvā mahātejā jagāma saha daivataiḥ ॥1-57-6॥

translations.english: Having heard the confused words uttered by the sages in a state of anger, the king said again:

verses.sloka: त्रिविष्टपम् ब्रह्म लोकम् लोकानाम् परम ईश्वरः ।विश्वामित्रो अपि तत् श्रुत्वा ह्रिया किंचित् अवाङ्मुखः ॥१-५७-७॥
verses.transliteration: triviṣṭapam brahma lokam lokānām parama īśvaraḥ ।viśvāmitro api tat śrutvā hriyā kiṁcit avāṅmukhaḥ ॥1-57-7॥

translations.english: "O Men endowed with the wealth of asceticism I was rejected by my guru and now by his sons. I shall seek another way. Farewell to you".

verses.sloka: दुःखेन महता आविष्टः स मन्युः इदम् अब्रवीत् ।तपः च सुमहत् तप्तम् राज ऋषिर् इति माम् विदुः ॥१-५७-८॥
verses.transliteration: duḥkhena mahatā āviṣṭaḥ sa manyuḥ idam abravīt ।tapaḥ ca sumahat taptam rāja ṛṣir iti mām viduḥ ॥1-57-8॥

translations.english: Having seen his fierce intent, the saint's sons were infuriated. They cursed him saying, "Be a Chandala"

verses.sloka: देवाः स ऋषि गणाः सर्वे न अस्ति मन्ये तपः फलम् ।एवम् निश्चित्य मनसा भूय एव महातपाः ॥१-५७-९॥
verses.transliteration: devāḥ sa ṛṣi gaṇāḥ sarve na asti manye tapaḥ phalam ।evam niścitya manasā bhūya eva mahātapāḥ ॥1-57-9॥

translations.english: With this the highsouled sons of Vasishta entered their hermitage. And one night after the king became a Chandala (a lowcaste man).
translations.hindi: जब विश्वामित्र के अखों-शाखों से उन यवनों को बसिष्ठ जीं में विकल देखा, तब उन्होंने शबला से कहा कि, अब की मेरे कहने से योग की महिमा से और म्लेच्छ उत्पन्न कर

verses.sloka: तपः चचार काकुत्स्थ परमम् परम आत्मवान् ।एतस्मिन् एव काले तु सत्य वादी जित इन्द्रियः ॥१-५७-१०॥
verses.transliteration: tapaḥ cacāra kākutstha paramam parama ātmavān ।etasmin eva kāle tu satya vādī jita indriyaḥ ॥1-57-10॥

translations.english: The king was tranformed into a darkcomplexioned dirty man with dishevelled hair. His body was besmeared with ashes and on his robes lay wreath collected from the cemetery. He had on him dark (soiled) clothes, and ornaments made of iron.

verses.sloka: त्रिशंकुः इति विख्यात इक्ष्वाकु कुल वर्धनः ।तस्य बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना यजेयम् इति राघव ॥१-५७-११॥
verses.transliteration: triśaṁkuḥ iti vikhyāta ikṣvāku kula vardhanaḥ ।tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā yajeyam iti rāghava ॥1-57-11॥

translations.english: "O Rama seeing him in the form of a chandala, all his counsellors, inhabitants of the city including his followers fled away.

verses.sloka: गच्छेयम् स्व शरीरेण देवानाम् परमाम् गतिम् ।वसिष्ठम् स समाहूय कथयामास चिन्तितम् ॥१-५७-१२॥
verses.transliteration: gaccheyam sva śarīreṇa devānām paramām gatim ।vasiṣṭham sa samāhūya kathayāmāsa cintitam ॥1-57-12॥

translations.english: O Descendant of Kakustha wandering alone burning with distress night and day the king went to Viswamitra who was rich in asceticism.

verses.sloka: अशक्यम् इति च अपि उक्तो वसिष्ठेन महात्मना ।प्रत्याख्यातो वसिष्ठेन स ययौ दक्षिणाम् दिशम् ॥१-५७-१३॥
verses.transliteration: aśakyam iti ca api ukto vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā ।pratyākhyāto vasiṣṭhena sa yayau dakṣiṇām diśam ॥1-57-13॥

translations.english: O Rama on seeing the king reduced to a useless a chandala, sage Viswamitra was touched with pity".

verses.sloka: ततः तत् कर्म सिद्धि अर्थम् पुत्रान् तस्य गतो नृपः ।वासिष्ठा दीर्घ तपसः तपो यत्र हि तेपिरे ॥१-५७-१४॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ tat karma siddhi artham putrān tasya gato nṛpaḥ ।vāsiṣṭhā dīrgha tapasaḥ tapo yatra hi tepire ॥1-57-14॥

translations.english: Exceedingly energetic and deeply pious, he looked at the king who was frightful in appearance and addressed him with compassion saying, "welfare to you".

verses.sloka: त्रिशंकुः सुमहातेजाः शतम् परम भास्वरम् ।वसिष्ठ पुत्रान् ददृशे तप्यमानान् यशस्विनः ॥१-५७-१५॥
verses.transliteration: triśaṁkuḥ sumahātejāḥ śatam parama bhāsvaram ।vasiṣṭha putrān dadṛśe tapyamānān yaśasvinaḥ ॥1-57-15॥

translations.english: "O Mighty prince what brings your here, for you are the heroic lord of Ayodhya? Whose curse turned you into a chandala"?

verses.sloka: सो अभिगम्य महात्मानः सर्वान् एव गुरोः सुतान् ।अभिवाद्य आनुपूर्व्येण ह्रिया किंचित् अवाङ्मुखः ॥१-५७-१६॥
verses.transliteration: so abhigamya mahātmānaḥ sarvān eva guroḥ sutān ।abhivādya ānupūrvyeṇa hriyā kiṁcit avāṅmukhaḥ ॥1-57-16॥

translations.english: In response to his words the king, who had fallen into the state of a chandala yet proficient in expression, spoke to one (Viswamitra) expert in speech, with folded hands.

verses.sloka: अब्रवीत् स महात्मनः सर्वान् एव कृतांजलिः ।शरणम् वः प्रपद्ये अहम् शरण्यान् शरणागतः ॥१-५७-१७॥
verses.transliteration: abravīt sa mahātmanaḥ sarvān eva kṛtāṁjaliḥ ।śaraṇam vaḥ prapadye aham śaraṇyān śaraṇāgataḥ ॥1-57-17॥

translations.english: "Rejected by my guru and his sons, what I achieved was disaster and what I could not was the fulfilment of my wish.

verses.sloka: प्रत्याख्यातो अस्मि भद्रम् वो वसिष्ठेन महात्मना ।यष्टु कामो महायज्ञम् तत् अनुज्ञातुम् अर्थथ ॥१-५७-१८॥
verses.transliteration: pratyākhyāto asmi bhadram vo vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā ।yaṣṭu kāmo mahāyajñam tat anujñātum arthatha ॥1-57-18॥

translations.english: O Gentle sage it is my intention to enter heaven with my physical body. I performed a hundred sacrifices but did not reap its fruit.

verses.sloka: गुरु पुत्रान् अहम् सर्वान् नमस् कृत्य प्रसादये ।शिरसा प्रणतो याचे ब्राह्मणान् तपसि स्थितान् ॥१-५७-१९॥
verses.transliteration: guru putrān aham sarvān namas kṛtya prasādaye ।śirasā praṇato yāce brāhmaṇān tapasi sthitān ॥1-57-19॥

translations.english: O Gentle sage I have never told a lie in spite of troubled circumstances, I shall never dabble in falsehood. I swear upon it by kshatriya morality .

verses.sloka: ते माम् भवन्तः सिद्धि अर्थम् याजयंतु समाहिताः ।स शरीरो यथा अहम् वै देव लोकम् अवाप्नुयाम् ॥१-५७-२०॥
verses.transliteration: te mām bhavantaḥ siddhi artham yājayaṁtu samāhitāḥ ।sa śarīro yathā aham vai deva lokam avāpnuyām ॥1-57-20॥

translations.english: I have performed various sacirifices and ruled over my people guided by the law of righteousness. I have pleased eminent elders with my conduct and character.

verses.sloka: प्रत्याख्यातो वसिष्ठेन गतिम् अन्याम् तपो धनाः ।गुरु पुत्रान् ऋते सर्वान् न अहम् पश्यामि कांचन ॥१-५७-२१॥
verses.transliteration: pratyākhyāto vasiṣṭhena gatim anyām tapo dhanāḥ ।guru putrān ṛte sarvān na aham paśyāmi kāṁcana ॥1-57-21॥

translations.english: O Preeminent among sages I endeavour to do my duty. I intend to perform a sacrifice. My gurus do not appreciate this.

verses.sloka: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् हि सर्वेषाम् पुरोधाः परमा गतिः ।तस्मात् अनंतरम् सर्वे भवन्तो दैवतम् मम ॥१-५७-२२॥
verses.transliteration: ikṣvākūṇām hi sarveṣām purodhāḥ paramā gatiḥ ।tasmāt anaṁtaram sarve bhavanto daivatam mama ॥1-57-22॥

translations.english: I consider destiny to be allpowerful. The effort of a man goes in vain. Everything is controlled by destiny. It is the supreme resort.
